name: The Labyrinths of Lunacy
text:
Standard
[skull]: -1. Reveal another token.
[cultist]: -3. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, lose 2 resources.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, discard a random card from your hand.
backText:
Hard
[skull]: -1. Reveal another token. If you fail, you must either take 1 damage or 1 horror.
[cultist]: -3. Place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. Lose 2 resources.
[elder_thing]: -4. Discard a random card from your hand.

name: Awakening
text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 1 doom on this agenda and no group has yet triggered this ability: The lead investigator of Group A chooses a random set-aside [[Act 1]] story card and draws it. Announce the chosen card's title to all three groups. Each other lead investigator draws that story card.
backText: Advance the current act card and follow its instructions. When you are instructed to resolve Act 2 Setup, those setup instructions can be found in the rules booklet (use the section for your Group).
flavor: You and two other groups been kidnapped and trapped for some kind of terrible experiment. The note for your group has further instructions.

text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 1 doom on this agenda and no group has yet triggered this ability: The lead investigator of Group A chooses a random set-aside [[Act 2]] story card and draws it. Announce the chosen card's title to all three groups. Each other lead investigator draws that story card.
backText: Advance the current act card and follow its instructions. When you are instructed to resolve Act 3 Setup, those setup instructions can be found in the rules booklet (use the section for your Group).
flavor:
As you escape from the first chamber, glowing words flicker into existence on your group's note:
"Have you made it out of the first chamber? Good. Perhaps you are not as useless as I suspected."

name: The Mastermind
text: Each [[Distortion]] location gains: "[action] [survivor]4+1< T %2[cultist]+: <+@2 H <@6@~+ [willpower]9 EIXODOLON. (Group limit once per game.)" Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.
backText: In this timeline, the ritual is complete. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, move all damage from Eixodolon to another group's copy of Eixodolon. Each investigator in this group is killed. (→R1)
flavor: You rush into the next chamber, hoping to find an exit to this nightmare. The locked steel gate before you crushes that hope. Cryptic symbols are etched into the walls, and a sigil on the floor ebbs with power. Just then, a figure exits from the shadows.

name: Sealed In (Group A)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. By the time the agenda advances, investigators must possess the Key of Mysteries and the requisite number of clues. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, each investigator in this group will be killed.)
backText:
If the investigators possess the Key of Mysteries and 2 [per_investigator] clues:
You push the key into the lock, and the wall of the chamber opens up, leading into a dark, narrow corridor of corrugated metal and concrete. The whistling of the pipes all around you dampens to a faint whimper.
The investigators spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. Remove the Key of Mysteries from the game. Resolve Act 2 Setup.
If the investigators do not possess the Key of Mysteries and/or 2 [per_investigator] clues:
A powerful, noxious gas spews forth from the vents and fills the room. Your vision grows hazy and you collapse to the ground. "The fate that inevitably awaits us all," a sinister voice explains. Everything goes dark.
Each investigator in this group is killed. (→R1)
flavor: "You have one hour to discover the way out," your note reads, "or you will breathe in death."

name: Watery Grave (Group B)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. By the time the agenda advances, investigators at the same location must possess the requisite number of clues. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, the investigator in the Chamber of Rain will be killed.)
backText:
If investigators at the same location possess 2 [per_investigator] clues:
You breath a sigh of relief as the water drains harmlessly.
Investigators at the same location spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. Resolve Act 2 Setup.
If investigators at the same location do not possess 2 [per_investigator] clues:
The water level continues to rise. It fills the tank and then your lungs. You struggle in futility against the glass. Freedom is so close, and yet so far.
Each investigator loses each of his or her clues. The investigator in the Chamber of Rain is killed. Resolve Act 2 Setup.
flavor: One member of your group is trapped inside one of this chamber's many tanks. A mechanism above the tank springs to life, and water pours into the tank from above. "You have one hour to find the means to free your companion," your note reads, "or their fate is sealed."

name: The Levers (Group C)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Regret. (Beware - If you pull the wrong lever, you will be killed.)
backText:
If an investigator activated the [action] ability on the Chamber of Regret, that investigator examines the Chamber of Secrets in Group A's play area to see if its flavor text matches the lever that was pulled. - If it does not match, rows of razor-sharp blades emerge from the walls of the chamber, dissecting you with horrifying precision. You are killed. Resolve Act 2 Setup. - If it matches, the gate ascends, and the door in the Chamber of Night opens. Resolve Act 2 Setup.
If no investigator activated the [action] ability on the Chamber of Regret:
Time is up. You rush to the levers, but you are too late. Rows of razor-sharp blades emerge from the walls of the chamber, dissecting you with horrifying precision.
The investigator nearest to the Chamber of Regret is killed. (In the event of a tie, the investigators decide.) Resolve Act 2 Setup.
flavor: "Only one of you can make the choice," your note reads. "Choose the correct lever, or die." An iron gate nearby opens with a deafening crash and reveals a small room that contains three unmarked levers.

name: The Levers (Group C)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Regret. Beware - If you pull the wrong lever, you will be killed
backText:
If an investigator activated the [action] ability on the Chamber of Regret, that investigator examines the Chamber of Secrets location underneath the scenario reference card to see if its flavor text matches the lever that was pulled. - If it does not match, rows of razor-sharp blades emerge from the walls of the chamber, dissecting you with horrifying precision. You are killed. Resolve Act 2 Setup. - If it matches, the gate ascends, and the door in the Chamber of Night opens. Resolve Act 2 Setup.

flavor: "Only one of you can make the choice," your note reads. "Choose the correct lever, or die." An iron gate nearby opens with a deafening crash and reveals a small room that contains three unmarked levers.

name: Distortions in Time (Group A)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. When the agenda advances, there must be at least 11 doom in play. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, each investigator in this group will be killed.)
backText:
If there was at least 11 doom in play when the agenda advanced:
You spin the dial on the device to its maximum value, struggling to keep hold of it as your muscles tighten and you begin to decay. The dial stops with a click, then slowly you are able to continue turning it in the same direction. You are in intense pain as it slowly turns, round and round, finally making it way back where it began. The air thins, and time returns to its original pace.
Resolve Act 3 Setup.
If there was less than 11 doom in play when the agenda advanced:
Your muscles and skin tighten, and you feel your body draining of energy. You try to scream, but no air escapes your throat. Your organs shrivel and decay. "The fate that inevitably awaits us all," a sinister voice explains. Within minutes, you are naught but dust.
Each investigator in this group is killed. (→R1)
flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. "Time flows differently in the next chamber," it reads. "If you do not act quickly, you will decay into ash."

name: Seeping Death (Group B)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Before the agenda advances, one investigator must activate the [action] ability on the Chamber of Poison.
backText:
If an investigator activated the [action] ability on the Chamber of Poison, that investigator reads the following: - If you have "been injected," the sludge is disgusting but harmless. Resolve Act 3 Setup. - If you have not "been injected," the poison seeps through your skin, devouring your organs from inside. You are killed. Resolve Act 3 Setup.
If no investigator activated the [action] ability on the Chamber of Poison:
The floors and walls of the entire labyrinth shift and turn, and you lose your balance. Sliding along the floor as gravity twists, you are knocked into the poisonous pit.
Move each investigator to the Chamber of Poison. Each investigator in this group who has not "been injected" is killed. Resolve Act 3 Setup.
flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. "The Chamber of Poison awaits," it reads. "One of you must open the way," your note reads. "A sacrifice, for the greater good."

name: The Pet (Group C)
text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Find a way to deal with Eixodolon's Pet before the agenda advances. (Beware - If the creature is still "locked away" when the agenda advances, it will break free.)
backText:
If you "sent Eixodolon's Pet to another group": Choose another group, at random. At the end of the current round, that group spawns their set-aside copy of Eixodolon's Pet in one of their Labyrinthine Halls. Resolve Act 3 Setup.
If Eixodolon's Pet is in the victory display:
You breathe a sigh of relief as the creature crumples lifelessly to the ground.
Resolve Act 3 Setup.
If neither of the above are true:
The creature smashes through the glass of its terrarium and lashes out hungrily at anyone nearby.
Move Eixodolon's Pet to Chamber of Hunger. It attacks each investigator in the Chamber of Hunger, in player order. Resolve Act 3 Setup.
flavor: Glowing words continue to appear on your note. "In the chamber ahead lives my precious pet," it reads. "He is very hungry. Perhaps you should open his gate and allow him to feed."

name: The Escape
text: Objective - At the end of the round, if Eixodolon has no remaining health, you may move any damage on him in excess of his health to another group's copy of Eixodolon. Then, advance.
backText:
If any copy of Eixodolon in any surviving group's play area has health remaining:
The figure distorts and shimmers through space-time.
Flip this act back over.
If each other surviving group's copy of Eixodolon has no health remaining: - If your group is the only surviving group, proceed to (→R2). - If only two groups survived, those groups proceed to (→R3). - If all three groups survived, all three groups proceed to (→R4).
flavor: "You are close to freedom," the figure's distorted voice crackles. "Do you still have hope in your voice? Do you still have light in your eyes?"

name: The Escape
text: Objective - If Eixodolon has no remaining health, advance.
backText:
If you are playing in standalone mode: Proceed to (→R2).
If you are playing as a mini-campaign and this is the first or second group played: Begin as a new group to discover which resolution is reached.
If you are playing as a mini-campaign, and this is the third group played: - If only one group survived, proceed to (→R2). - If two groups survived, proceed to (→R3). - If all three groups survived, proceed to (→R4).
flavor: "You are close to freedom," the figure's distorted voice crackles. "Do you still have hope in your voice? Do you still have light in your eyes?"

flavor:

Perhaps it is a clue… but for what?

name: Chamber of Rain
text: The Chamber of Rain is sealed shut while the water flows. While it is Act 1, this location gains: "Investigators cannot move into or out of this location. Forced - When an investigator here draws an enemy card: Discard it and draw a new card to replace it."

name: Chamber of Sorrows
text: [action]: Test [combat] (1) to try to break down the door to the flooding terrarium. Regardless of whether you succeed or fail, it does not budge. Remember that you "tried your best."

name: Chamber of Sorrows
text: [action]: Test [willpower] (2) to interpret the diagram inscribed on the glass. If you succeed, take control of 1 clue on an investigator in either Chamber of Sorrows or Chamber of Rain (or from that location if you are the only investigator in the game). Any investigator in either Chamber of Sorrows or Chamber of Rain may perform this action.

name: Chamber of Night
text: [action]: You call out for help as loud as you can. Nobody responds.
flavor: The wooden shelves in this dark chamber are so rotten, you're surprised they can hold anything without falling apart.

name: Chamber of Night
text: [action]: Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, you notice strange writing inscribed along the wall; look at the revealed side of the location underneath the scenario reference card. When you are satisfied, place it back underneath the scenario reference card.

name: Chamber of Regret
text:
No more than one investigator may be in the Chamber of Regret at a time.
[action] The investigators spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You pull one of the 3 levers (choose one): left, middle, or right. As soon as you do, the gate slams shut behind you. You cannot leave the Chamber of Regret for the remainder of the current act.
backText: No more than one investigator may be in the Chamber of Regret at a time.

name: Labyrinthine Halls
text: [fast] Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: You find an old lockbox in a pile of refuse, and decide to leave something behind. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator draws 2 cards. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: As you travel further down these halls, you are assaulted by a putrid stench.

name: Labyrinthine Halls
text: [fast] Spend 4 resources: You find the corpse of someone you think you once knew, and wish you could have saved them. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator gains 4 resources. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The corpses of gaunt creatures fill this section of the complex - some natural, others uncanny.

name: Labyrinthine Halls
text: [action][action]: You peer through an overgrown mirror and see an unfamiliar reflection. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator may take 2 additional actions during his or her next turn. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: As you continue through the halls, you find moss, mold and ivy creeping along the walls and floor.

name: Chamber of Hunger
text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Hunger: There is something strange drawn on the glass. Take control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram.
flavor: It's like a zoo for a sadist.

name: Chamber of Decay
text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Decay: There's a journal here with some strange scribblings. Take control of the set-aside Decay Diagram.
flavor: The air is thick and humid. It stings your eyes and causes you to cough uncontrollably.

name: Chamber of Rot
text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Rot: There is something strange etched on the walls. Take control of the set-aside Rot Diagram.
flavor: A trap door along the floor leads down into a separate chamber.

name: Chamber of Poison
text: [action]: You cross the noxious pit and turn the valve at the end. (Beware - activating this ability without the antidote may be deadly.)
backText: The ladder leading into the Chamber of Poison must be lowered. As an additional cost to enter the Chamber of Poison, investigators in the Chamber of Rot must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
flavor: The yellow-green sludge bubbles and froths dreadfully. Across the pit, you see a control panel with a lone copper valve.

name: Abandoned Warehouse
flavor: Two other heavy vault doors lead into the Abandoned Warehouse, sealed tightly shut. You can hear voices from the other side and all around you, as though stretching across multiple dimensions.

name: Arcane Runes
text:
In your chamber, you see a set of arcane runes etched upon the wall. If you can decode them and set them in the correct order, perhaps it will change something...

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
If you are in Group B:
Etched upon the glass of the capsule slowly filling with water, you can see a blueprint begin to glow.
Each investigator in this group may immediately trade clues among one another. Move any number of clues from Chamber of Rain to Chamber of Sorrows, or vice-versa. Flip this card back over.
If you are in Group A:
The runes glow, and a piece of the wall slides to reveal a secret compartment, filled with trinkets.
Put the Key of Mysteries into play at the Chamber of Secrets. Flip this card back over.
If you are in Group C:
The runes in your chamber shift to form a word.
The word you see is the same word inscribed upon the wall of the Chamber of Secrets in Group A's play area (you may examine Group A's play area) Flip this card back over.

name: The Rift
text:
With a sudden flash of light, a rift begins to open in the wall nearby, energy slowly coalescing into the shape of a portal. It is too small to enter now, but soon it will be large enough for a person to step through...
Revelation - Attach The Rift to the current act. If it is act 1, Groups B and C put the set-aside Key of Mysteries into play at a [[Distortion]] location. Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 3 doom on each group's agenda: The rift opens wide enough for an investigator to step through. Choose an investigator at any location to enter the rift. Then, that investigator flips this card over and follows the instructions on its other side.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
You find yourself in a hub, of sorts - a pathway within the aether. Other prisoners have found their way here. Perhaps you can collaborate with them to find a way to escape.
Each investigator that entered the rift takes this story card and meets in private, away from each group. Investigators within the rift can speak freely, and may exchange any number of clues, resources, cards in hand, or story assets controlled. Once the investigators are satisfied, each investigator returns to his or her original group. Flip this card back over.

name: The Vent
text:
You find a ventilation shaft through which you can fit some important items...
Revelation - Place The Vent in a [[Distortion]] location. If it is act 1, Groups B and C put the set-aside Key of Mysteries into play at that location. [fast]: Place any number of your resource tokens or clues on this card, and/or place any number of [[Item]] assets you control underneath this card. You may also place a written note underneath this card. [action]: Take control of any number of tokens, cards, or notes on/underneath this card. [reaction] At the end of the round: You send all of the tokens and cards gathered here through the ventilation shaft. Flip this card over and follow the instructions on the other side.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
The objects tumble down through the shaft, making loud banging noises behind the walls and underneath the floor. Hopefully another group can find them...
Take the cards, tokens, and notes on or underneath this card and place them on or underneath another group's copy of The Vent. Flip this card back over.

name: The Dilemma
text:
Glowing words appear on your group's note as though written by an unseen entity. It reads: "Worry not. I shall give your friends a chance to escape. All you have to do is perish at their expense, and they will be given the means to escape. Just write 'I choose death' on this note here, and the deed will be done."
Revelation - Put The Dilemma into play, next to the act deck. The current act gains: "[reaction] At the end of the round: Desperate, you are willing to sacrifice yourself for the benefit of the other groups. Flip The Dilemma over and follow the instructions on the other side."

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
You write "I choose death" on the note. Words appear just below yours, spelling out a sentence in reply. "Did you really think I would let you die that easily?"
You must choose and discard all but X cards from your hand, and remove all but X resources from your resource pool. X is the amount of doom on the current agenda.
Read the following to each group aloud:
The words and letters on the note shift and change to form a strange diagram.
The lead investigator of Group A takes control of the set-aside Rot Diagram. The lead investigator of Group B takes control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram. The lead investigator of Group C takes control of the set-aside Decay Diagram. Remove each group's copy of The Dilemma from the game.

name: The Gate
text:
You notice a doorway in your chamber that wasn't there before. On the other side, the hall is pitch black. Where does it lead?
Revelation - Attach The Gate to a [[Distortion]] location. [action] Spend 1 clue: You enter the doorway. Flip this story card over and follow the instructions on its other side.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
As soon as you step through the gate, it vanishes behind you. You are on your own, for now...
Depending on which group you are in, put a different location into play, as follows: - If you are in Group A, put the Chamber of Rot into play. - If you are in Group B, put the Chamber of Hunger into play. - If you are in Group C, put the Chamber of Decay into play. Disengage from each enemy and move to the location just put into play. Until there is at least 5 doom on the current agenda, that location is not considered to be connected to any other location. Remove this card from the game.

name: Encrypted Glyphs
text:
In your chamber, you see three lines of strange glyphs etched upon the wall. One line seems brighter than the others.
Revelation - Attach Encrypted Glyphs to a [[Distortion]] location. Forced - If there is at least 1 horror and 1 [per_investigator] damage on this card: Flip it over and follow the instructions on its other side. [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to attempt to decipher the glyphs. If you succeed, place 1 damage on this card. [action]: Test [willpower] (4) to move the glyphs to their proper order. If you succeed, place 1 horror on each group's copy of Encrypted Glyphs.

name: Deep Within the Labyrinth...
text:
The runes in the chamber glow, and a strange message is spelled out across the wall.
If you are in Group A: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Rot Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
If you are in Group B: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram. Remove this card from the game.
If you are in Group C: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Decay Diagram. Remove this card from the game.

flavor: Emblazoned across the handle is the letter B.

name: Decay Diagram
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Decay Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Hunger, it gains: "[action] If Eixodolon's Pet is 'locked away,' spend 1 clue: Deal 4 damage to Eixodolon's Pet."
flavor: Perhaps one of the groups can make sense of this?

name: Decay Diagram
text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of Decay Diagram to another investigator. While you are in the Chamber of Decay, it gains: "[action]: Place 1 doom here. Flip any number of your clues to their doom side and place them here."

name: Eixodolon
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Eixodolon gets +6 [per_investigator] health and cannot be defeated by damage. Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if there is a copy of Harvested Pain in the victory display: Ready Eixodolon.

text: Spawn - Nearest [[Prison]] location. Hunter. Forced - After Faceless Abductor attacks an investigator: Move that investigator to a [[Prison]] location.

name: Tortured Victim
text: Revelation - You must either discard a random card from your hand, or Tortured Victim makes an immediate attack against you.

name: Mi-Go Guard
text: Prey - Most remaining health. For each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token revealed during an attack against Mi-Go Guard, that attack deals 1 fewer damage.

name: Unnatural Weariness
text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must choose a different option: - Lose 3 resources. - Lose 1 action. - Discard a random card from your hand.

name: Poisonous Gas
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, lose 1 action (2 actions instead if you fail by 2 or more). When this skill test begins, an investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on your location to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2.

name: Dreadful Mechanism
text: Revelation - Put Dreadful Mechanism into play in your threat area. Forced - After you perform an action other than the [action] ability below: Take 1 damage, discard an asset taking up at least 1 hand slot, and discard Dreadful Mechanism. [action]: Test [combat] (2). If you succeed, discard Dreadful Mechanism.

name: Blood and Rust
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 1 damage (2 damage instead if you fail by 2 or more). When this skill test begins, an investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on your location to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2.

name: Paradox Effect
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. If you succeed, put Paradox Effect into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Paradox Effect and choose an investigator in another group. You and that investigator may talk in private and may exchange resources, story assets, and cards in hand.

name: Paradox Effect
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.
flavor:
Reality wavers.
Reality splits.
Reality reforms, and the paradox collapses.

name: Harvested Pain
text: Peril. Revelation - If you have 3 or fewer remaining health or sanity, add Harvested Pain to the victory display. Otherwise, take 1 damage and 1 horror. While Harvested Pain is in the victory display, Eixodolon gets +1 fight.

name: The Midwinter Gala
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of [[Guest]] assets at your location (to a maximum of 5).
[tablet]: -2. (-4 instead if you are at a [[Private]] location).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail or if The Bloodless Man is at your location, take 1 horror.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 plus the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of story assets at your location.
[tablet]: -3 (-5 instead if you are at a [[Private]] location).
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail or if The Bloodless Man is at your location, take 1 horror.

name: Masked Revelers
text: Each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be dealt damage. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
backText: Shuffle each set-aside [[Monster]] enemy, both copies of the Vicious Ambush treachery, and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
flavor: Promising to be a night of intrigue and wonder, the gala is expected to be filled with secrets and whispers that are as much a part of the entertainment as the drinks and music.

name: Unexpected Guests
text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
backText:
If The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) is in play:
You turn around to see the Bloodless Man striding toward you with murderous intent. Before you can react, the imposing figure staggers, then falls face first onto the red carpet.

Moments later, a sharp sound of ripping cloth breaks the silence. Glistening appendages erupt from the Bloodless Man's torn suit and limbs, blossoming into a grotesque amalgam of flesh and writhing tentacles. Your stomach churns as the creature's bone-white mask stares down at you, set in a maw of nightmarish limbs and gnashing fangs.
Flip The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) to his (Unleashed) side.
Otherwise:
The clamor around you seems to quiet for a moment.
Each investigator may heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Guest]] asset at their location.
flavor: Commotion stirs deeper within the manor as various guests ask the attendants to be let out. Other guests shuffle through the manor with dead eyes and blank stares.

name: A Killer Party
text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
backText: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
flavor: The party descends into utter mayhem, with guests throwing themselves out of glass doors and windows to escape the otherworldly monstrosities.

name: Meet and Greet
text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. [action] If you control a [[Guest]] asset: Give control of it to another investigator at your location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator controls a [[Guest]] asset and the current agenda is 2a or 3a, they may spend the requisite amount of clues, as a group, to advance.
backText: Choose one of the set-aside [[Second Floor]] locations at random and put it into play directly above the Lobby. For the rest of the game, that location is connected to the Lobby, and vice versa. Put the other 2 set-aside locations into play in a row to the right of the previously placed [[Second Floor]] location. Put the set-aside rival story card into play next to the agenda, [[Rival]] side faceup, and follow its Setup text. Read Interlude: The Fabled Jewel (page 13).
flavor: You notice the Jewel is no longer in the ballroom. Maybe a guest saw someone move it?

name: Finding the Jewel
text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. Objective - Complete the objective on your faction story card, and try to accomplish as many tasks as you can (see page 24 of the rulebook).
flavor: You must help your contact and their associates, no matter the cost.

name: Lobby
text: [fast] If the current agenda is 2a or 3a, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Someone is fashionably late. Reveal the top card of the Guest deck and put it into play at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: The winter chill lingers in your bones. Something feels wrong.

name: Lantern Chamber
text:
[fast] During your turn, name a card: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. If it is the named card, cancel its effects and discard it. Discover 1 clue at this location. (Limit once per turn.)
[action] If this location has no clues: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, flip over any spellbound card.
backText: As an additional cost to enter this location, you must take 1 horror.

name: Art Gallery
text: [action]: There's more to be discovered in this room full of strange works of art. Place up to 2 clues (from the token pool) on this location. Gain 2 resources. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: There's nothing quite like the pieces on display here.

name: Ballroom
text: [action]: Parley. You persuade two of the guests to have a dance. Exhaust 2 [[Guest]] assets at this location. Then, heal 1 horror from each of them.
flavor: They're playing "Sogno e Follia in D Minor" by a little known composer named E. Zann.

name: Barroom
text: [fast] Spend 1 resource: Buy a drink! Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator or [[Guest]] asset at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: "This jag juice has a nice kick!"

name: Bedroom
text: [action] Choose an enemy at any [[Second Floor]] location: Fight. You may use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 clue for this attack to deal +2 damage. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Library
text:
You get +1 skill value while parleying at this location.
[fast] If the Jewel of Sarnath is at this location: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, either place 1 damage on the Jewel of Sarnath or remove 1 token from it. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Parlor
text:
This location gets -1 shroud for each [[Guest]] asset at it (to a minimum of 1 shroud).
[fast] If you control the Jewel of Sarnath: Exhaust an enemy at any location. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: A moon-beast in a bottle? How bizarre.

name: The Foundation [guardian]
text: Forced - When The Bloodless Man (Unleashed) is defeated: If the Jewel of Sarnath is attached to him, attach it to his location. [action] If the Jewel of Sarnath is at your location and The Bloodless Man is not in play: Take control of the Jewel of Sarnath and place 1 damage on it. Objective - At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath, they may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance the act. End of game scoring: 4 points if no non-weakness enemies are in play (2 points instead if exactly one non-weakness enemy is in play).
flavor: The 'authorities' seem to want you to acquire the Jewel by force. Good luck taking it from the Bloodless Man.

name: The Foundation [guardian]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Rookie Cop enemy into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Valeriya Antonova card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Valeriya Antonova is at your location: Parley. Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Valeriya Antonova to the victory display. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and all play areas for Rookie Cop and remove it from the game. If the encounter deck was searched, shuffle it.
flavor: The Foundation doesn't take kindly to your interest in the Jewel. If you make a show of force, you might convince them to back down.

name: Valeriya Antonova
text: You get +1 [combat]. [action] Exhaust Valeriya Antonova: Ready another [[Guest]] asset at your location. You get +1 to your next skill test this round for each [[Guest]] asset at your location. Forced - When Valeriya Antonova leaves play: Remove her from the game.

name: Valeriya Antonova
text: Aloof. Hunter. Valeriya Antonova cannot be damaged. Each investigator at this location gets -1 to each of their skills if they control an exhausted [[Guest]] asset. Forced - When the round ends: Exhaust each [[Guest]] asset at this location.

name: Archibald Hudson
text:
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Archibald Hudson: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck. Then, exhaust that enemy and gain 3 resources.
[action] Spend 1 resource: Move 1 damage from an asset at your location to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.

name: Special Agent Callahan
text: [action]: Fight. Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1. [reaction] After you trigger an [action] ability on an [[Ally]] or [[Weapon]] asset, exhaust Special Agent Callahan: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: "Say hello to my lil' boy, Tommy!"

name: Horacio Martinez
text: While you control Horacio Martinez, he may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location. [reaction] After a non-[[Elite]] enemy attacks you, exhaust Horacio Martinez: Exhaust that enemy and it cannot ready this round (do not disengage from it).

name: Rookie Cop
text: Surge. Aloof. Hunter. Forced - After an investigator at this location attacks another enemy: Deal 1 damage to that investigator.

name: Miskatonic University [seeker]
text: Declan Pearce cannot be damaged or leave play while the Jewel of Sarnath is attached to him. [action] If Declan Pearce is at your location: Parley. Place up to 2 of your clues on Declan Pearce. Then, if 3 [per_investigator] or more clues are on him, take control of the Jewel of Sarnath and add Declan Pearce to the victory display. Objective - At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath, they may advance the act. End of game scoring: 1 point per 2 [per_investigator] total cards in hand among all investigators (to a maximum of 4 points).
flavor: You are assisting Dean Caldwell with "acquiring" the Jewel, but first you will have to persuade Declan Pearce to give it up.

name: Miskatonic University [seeker]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Confusion treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Caldwell Philips card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Caldwell Philips is at your location: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Caldwell Philips to the victory display. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Confusion and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: The eggheads at Miskatonic University seem to think this Jewel belongs in their museum. Perhaps you can help them see reason.

name: Caldwell Philips
text: You get +1 [intellect]. [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues, exhaust Caldwell Philips: Draw that number of cards (to a maximum of 3). Forced - When Caldwell Philips leaves play: Remove him from the game.

name: Caldwell Philips
text: Aloof. Hunter. Caldwell Philips cannot be damaged. Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Choose and discard a non-weakness card from your hand.

name: Dr. Mya Badry
text: Your maximum hand size is increased by 2. [action] Exhaust Dr. Mya Badry: Investigate. Your base [intellect] value for this investigation is equal to the number of cards in your hand.
flavor: "Disturbingly lifelike, isn't it?"

name: Lucas Tetlow
text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered at your location, exhaust Lucas Tetlow: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Item]] asset and draw it. If it is a [[Relic]], gain 2 resources. If it is a [[Tome]], you may play it (paying its cost). If it is a [[Tool]], discover 1 clue at a connecting location. Shuffle your deck.

name: Elizabeth Conrad
text: [reaction] After you draw a card during your turn, exhaust Elizabeth Conrad: Choose an investigator at your location to move to a connecting location.
flavor: "Has anyone else tried the giggle juice? It's fantastic!"

name: Confusion
text: Surge. Confusion cannot be canceled. Revelation - Place 2 of your clues on your location. For each clue you cannot place, take 1 horror.
flavor: What is this???

name: The Syndicate [rogue]
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Look at a mystery (a facedown card) beneath your location. [fast] During your turn, if there are 1 [per_investigator] or fewer clues on a location with a mystery: Draw that mystery. Objective - Find the Jewel of Sarnath and escape. At the end of the round, if an investigator at the Lobby controls the Jewel of Sarnath, the investigators may spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance the act. End of game scoring: 1 point per 3 [per_investigator] resources among all investigators (to a maximum of 4 points).
flavor: It's a job, and nothing more. If you can abscond with the Jewel, you know you'll be handsomely rewarded.

name: The Syndicate [rogue]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Cold Streak treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Johnny Valone card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Johnny Valone is at your location: Parley. Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Johnny Valone to the victory display. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Cold Streak and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: The mob are easily angered, but you might be able to convince Johnny Valone that giving up the Jewel is in his best interest...

name: Johnny Valone
text: You get +1 [agility]. [reaction] After you gain 1 or more resources via a card effect, exhaust Johnny Valone: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. Forced - When Johnny Valone leaves play: Remove him from the game.
flavor: "Fifty clams when the job's done."

name: Johnny Valone
text: Aloof. Hunter. Johnny Valone cannot be damaged. Forced - When you end your turn at Johnny Valone's location: Lose 2 resources.
flavor: "The debt must be paid!"

name: Miranda Keeper
text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply: Place 1 resource on your location, as an antiquity. You get +2 to your next skill test this round.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, remove an antiquity from your location: Gain 2 resources.
flavor: "You slay me."

name: Arsène Renard
text:
[fast]: Place 1 resource on each location, as an antiquity. (Group limit once per game.)
[fast]: If there is an exhausted enemy at your location, remove an antiquity from your location: Either draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.

name: Nova Malone
text: [action] Exhaust Nova Malone: Fight. Your base [combat] value for this fight is equal to the number of resources in your resource pool (to a maximum of 7). This attack deals +1 damage. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Gain 1 resource. (Limit once per round.)

name: Cold Streak
text: Surge. Cold Streak cannot be canceled. Revelation - Lose 4 resources. For each resource you cannot lose, take either 1 damage or 1 horror.
flavor: It's just not your night.

name: Silver Twilight Lodge [mystic]
text: [action]: You try to sense the Jewel's presence. Discard the top card of the encounter deck. You may draw that card. (Group limit twice per round.) Objective - Find the Jewel of Sarnath. At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath, they may spend 5 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance the act. End of game scoring: 1 point for each treachery with no victory points in the victory display (to a maximum of 4 points).
flavor: Carl Sanford has promised you a lavish reward for acquiring the Jewel. But can you really trust him?

name: Silver Twilight Lodge [mystic]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Ward of Preservation treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Carl Sanford card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If Carl Sanford is at your location: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and Carl Sanford to the victory display. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and all play areas for Ward of Preservation and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: Perhaps you can gently convince Sanford and the Lodge to leave well enough alone.

name: Carl Sanford
text: You get +1 [willpower]. You have one additional arcane slot. [reaction] After a revelation effect on a non-weakness treachery is canceled, exhaust Carl Sanford: Add that treachery to the victory display. Draw 1 card. Forced - When Carl Sanford leaves play: Remove him from the game.

name: Carl Sanford
text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Carl Sanford cannot be damaged.
Each investigator at this location gets -1 [willpower].
flavor: "The Jewel is mine."

name: Prudence Douglas
text:
Uses (3 portents).
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 portent and exhaust Prudence Douglas: Look at the top 4 cards of the encounter deck. Discard up to 2 non-[[Elite]] cards from among them and put the rest back on top in any order.

name: Sarah Van Shaw
text: [action] Spend up to 2 resources and exhaust Sarah Van Shaw: Fight. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this attack. For each resource spent, this attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: "Ares, Hades, heel. Good boys!"

name: Raymond Loggins
text:
Uses (4 truths).
[reaction] When you draw a non-weakness treachery, spend 1 truth: Cancel that card's revelation effect and discard it. Then, take 1 horror.

name: Ward of Preservation
text: Surge. Ward of Preservation cannot be canceled. Revelation - Put Ward of Preservation into play in your threat area. Forced - When you play an event: Cancel its effects and take 1 horror. Then, discard Ward of Preservation.

name: Locals of Kingsport [survivor]
text: Forced - When Declan Pearce is defeated: Attach the Jewel of Sarnath to his location. [action] If the Jewel of Sarnath is attached to your location: You attempt to purge the corruption from the Jewel. Test [combat] or [agility] (3). If you succeed, remove 1 token from it. You may take control of it. Objective - At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath and it has no tokens on it, they may spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance the act. End of game scoring: 4 points, minus 1 point for each card in the guest deck (to a minimum of 0 points).
flavor: Bain has hinted at the dangerous power of the Jewel. Perhaps if you can wrest control of it from Declan Pearce, this nightmare will end.

name: Locals of Kingsport [survivor]
text: Setup: Shuffle the set-aside Unlucky treachery into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside William Bain card into play at the lead investigator's location, enemy side faceup. [action] If William Bain is at your location: Parley. Test any skill (4). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on this story card. Forced - When there are 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] clues on this story card: Add it and William Bain to the victory display. Search the encounter deck, encounter discard pile, and all play areas for Unlucky and remove it from the game. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: The locals don't seem to have taken kindly to your involvement. Perhaps you can show them you don't mean any harm.

name: William Bain
text: While there are 1 or more cards committed to a skill test you are performing, you get +1 to each of your skills. [reaction] After you commit 1 or more cards to a skill test, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources and exhaust William Bain: Reveal the top card of the Guest deck and put it into play at the Lobby. Forced - When William Bain leaves play: Remove him from the game.

name: William Bain
text:
Aloof. Hunter.
William Bain cannot be damaged.
Each investigator at this location cannot commit cards to skill tests.
flavor: "Phonus balonus; I know you're with them."

name: Delores Gadling
text:
While investigating and parleying, you get +1 [intellect] for each [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location.
You may ignore each attack of opportunity made by [[Humanoid]], non-[[Elite]] enemies against you.
flavor: "That club made me do terrible things. We must stop them."

name: Thomas Olney
text:
[fast] Name a [[Trait]] and exhaust Thomas Olney: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card has the named [[Trait]], gain 2 resources.
[fast] During a skill test at your location, exhaust Thomas Olney: Discard the top card of your deck. You may commit that card to this skill test, if able.

name: Claire Wilson
text: [reaction] After you commit 1 or more cards to a skill test you are performing, exhaust Claire Wilson: You get +1 skill value for this test.
flavor: "I should've stayed home."

name: Unlucky
text: Surge. Unlucky cannot be canceled. Revelation - Put Unlucky into play in your threat area. You get -2 to each of your skills. Forced - When the round ends: Discard Unlucky.

name: The Bloodless Man
text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest location with a [[Guest]]). Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Instead flip him over, exhaust him, and heal all but 3 [per_investigator] damage from him. Forced - When the investigation phase ends, if this enemy is ready: Deal 1 horror to each investigator and [[Guest]] asset at this location. If The Pale Lantern is attached to this enemy, each [[Guest]] asset at this location becomes spellbound.

name: The Bloodless Man
text: Hunter. Massive. Forced - After this enemy attacks you: Remove a [[Guest]] asset you control from the game, ignoring the agenda's Forced effect.

name: The Pale Lantern
text: [action] If The Bloodless Man has 1 or more damage on him or is in the victory display: Test [combat] or [agility] (3). If you succeed, take control of The Pale Lantern and flip it over. Any investigator at this location may trigger this ability. Forced - When The Pale Lantern would leave play: Attach it to its location instead.

name: The Pale Lantern
text: [action]: Flip over a spellbound card at your location. [action] Exhaust The Pale Lantern: Test [combat] or [agility] (2). If you succeed, place 1 damage on it. Then, if there is 4 damage on it, you break it; add it to the victory display (ignoring its Forced effect) and flip over each spellbound card. Forced - When The Pale Lantern would leave play: Flip it over and attach it to its location instead.

name: Enraged Gug
text:
Alert. Hunter.
Horror dealt by this enemy must be assigned to [[Guest]] assets you control, if able.
flavor: "I wasn't expecting this kind of entertainment!" - Elizabeth Conrad

name: Abhorrent Moon-Beast
text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Damage dealt by this enemy must be assigned to [[Guest]] assets you control, if able.
flavor: "Life imitates Art far more than Art imitates Life." - Oscar Wilde

name: Savage Shantak
text:
Hunter.
Savage Shantak gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each [[Guest]] asset at its location.
flavor: And they whispered also that the rumoured Shantak-birds are no wholesome things... - H.P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>

name: Vicious Ambush
text: Revelation - If no [[Monster]] enemies are in play, Vicious Ambush gains surge. Otherwise, the nearest [[Monster]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.

name: Declan Pearce
text: Hunter. Declan Pearce gets +2 [per_investigator] health. While Declan Pearce is engaged with you, you get 1 fewer action during your turn. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Declan Pearce is ready: Heal 1 damage from each enemy in play.

name: Jewel of Sarnath
text: Revelation - Put Jewel of Sarnath into play under your control with 3 damage and 1 doom on it. Forced - When Jewel of Sarnath leaves play: Shuffle it into the encounter deck. [fast] Exhaust Jewel of Sarnath: Test [willpower] or [agility] (1). If you succeed, move 1 token on it to an enemy at your location.

name: Lantern Club Member
text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Parley. Automatically evade this enemy (you may spend 2 additional resources to discard it instead).
flavor: "I hear Nomarch Pearce has quite the evening in store."

name: Bleeding Walls
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X). X is the shroud value of your location. If you fail, lose 1 action and take 1 horror.
flavor: They needed redecorating anyway.

name: Entrap
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail and... - ...The Bloodless Man is at your location, a [[Guest]] asset you control becomes spellbound. - ...The Bloodless Man is at another location, he readies, moves (one location at a time) until he reaches your location, and engages you. - ...The Bloodless Man is not in play, Entrap gains surge.

name: Inexplicable Cold
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). For each point you fail by, you must choose one: - Choose and discard 1 card from your play area. - Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. - Take 1 damage.

name: Mind Extraction
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X). X is 1 plus the current agenda number. If you fail, take 2 horror. Then, if The Bloodless Man is in play and an investigator controls The Pale Lantern, flip it over and attach it to The Bloodless Man (leaving all tokens on it).

name: Noxious Fumes
text: Revelation - In player order, each investigator at your location must choose: - Test [agility] (3) to attempt to flee before the gas fills the room. If you succeed, move to a connecting location. If you fail, take 2 damage. - Test [combat] (3) to attempt to hold your breath. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

name: Pushed into the Beyond
text: Revelation - Choose and shuffle a non-story asset you control into its owner's deck. Discard the top 3 cards of that deck. If a copy of that asset is discarded, take 2 horror.
flavor: Push it.

name: Secret Door
text: Revelation - Attach to the location with the most investigators, and without a Secret Door attached. Investigators cannot leave this location. [action]: Test [willpower] (3) to search for the passage or [intellect] (3) to discern the way out. If you succeed, discard Secret Door.

name: Terror Gate
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if a [[Rival]] enemy is in play. If you fail and you allied with... - ...the [guardian] faction, take 2 damage. - ...the [seeker] faction, discard 2 cards from your hand. - ...the [rogue] faction, lose 3 resources. - ...the [mystic] faction, take 2 horror. - ...the [survivor] faction, lose 1 action.

name: Violent Commands
text: Revelation - Put Violent Commands into play in your threat area. [action]: Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location and discard Violent Commands. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror.

name: Film Fatale
text:
Standard
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -3 (-5 instead if there is a [[Monster]] enemy at your location).
[tablet]: -3. If there is a [[Saturnite]] enemy at your location, reveal another token.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail and there is a [[Dinosaur]] enemy at your location, ready that enemy. That enemy attacks you.
backText:
Hard
[skull]: -X. X is 2 more than the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -4 (-6 instead if there is a [[Monster]] enemy at your location).
[tablet]: -4. If there is a [[Saturnite]] enemy at your location, reveal another token.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail and there is a [[Dinosaur]] enemy at your location, ready that enemy. That enemy attacks you.

name: Showbusiness As Usual
text: As you walk with André, he mentions the trouble around the lot all started when the producer, Erika Strand, found the "deal of the century" on three props for the films. Ever since then, people have been acting strange, things have been disappearing, and the world just doesn't seem right.
backText:
If it is act 1a:
As you continue to investigate, the air around Lot C becomes heavy and sour. Something is happening.
Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror. Gather 1 random [[Prop]] asset beneath Central Lot and set it aside, out of play. Add each remaining [[Prop]] asset beneath Central Lot to the victory display. Advance directly to act 1b.
Otherwise:
Your head spins. The world around you doesn't look quite right, although you can't say why, exactly.
Each investigator tests their lowest skill (2). Each investigator who fails loses 2 resources and loses 1 action during their next turn. Remember "the investigators made their call time."

name: Colliding Realities
text: Forced - The first time each round an investigator draws a copy of Bleeding Reality: After resolving its effects, that investigators draws the top card of the Reel deck.
backText: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
flavor: Reality continues to warp and bend. It isn't just one film coming to life: all three are blending together in pure chaos.

name: André's Request
text: Each Possessed Extra gains aloof. Objective - Investigate as many of the cursed props as you can. At the end of the round, if there are 2 or more [[Prop]] assets in the victory display, the investigators may advance.
backText: Each investigator loses all of their clues. If there are any remaining cards beneath Central Lot, set them aside, out of play. Find the set-aside André Patel story asset and put it into play under the control of any investigator. He does not take up an ally slot for the remainder of the scenario. Proceed to Interlude: Take Two (page 8).
flavor: The mishaps that have plagued Lot C all seem to stem from several strange props. By tracking them down, you may be able to put a stop to these unfortunate events.

name: Helios Telescope
text:
Uses (0 shards).
[action] Spend 1 shard: Discard an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Then, for each remaining shard on Helios Telescope, deal 1 damage to an [[Elite]] enemy at any location.

name: Staff of the Serpent
text: Damage cannot be assigned to Staff of the Serpent except by the ability below. [action] If it is act 3: Fight. Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, deal 1 damage to Staff of the Serpent (2 damage instead of the defeated enemy is [[Elite]]).

name: Accursed Cape
text: Accursed Cape gets +2 [per_investigator] health. When damage would be placed on attached enemy, place 1 of that damage on Accursed Cape. Forced - When Accursed Cape is defeated: Place it in the victory display.

name: Central Lot
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Add the topmost card beneath Central Lot to the victory display.

name: Central Lot
text: Forced - When the round ends, if there are no clues on Central Lot: Place clues on Central Lot up to its clue value.
flavor: Saturnites and werewolves and dinosaurs, oh my!

name: Space Set
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, lose 1 action. [action]: Play an asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2. (Limit once per game.)

name: Jungle Set
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, you must either take 1 damage or discard an asset you control. [action]: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. Choose a revealed [[Item]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

name: Gothic Set
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Test [combat] (2). If you fail, ready the nearest enemy. It moves towards, engages, and attacks the nearest investigator. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy at Gothic Set: Heal 1 horror.

name: Flip the Script
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (0). Each matching skill icon committed to this test subtracts from your skill value instead of adding to it. For each point you succeed by, you must either take 1 horror or place 1 of your clues on your location (to a maximum of 3).

name: Found Footage
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is equal to your location's shroud value. If you fail, take 2 horror.

name: Action!
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Lose 2 actions. - Each investigator at your location takes 1 damage and 1 horror.

name: "Break a Leg!"
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 damage, or choose and discard a non-story [[Item]] asset you control.

name: Bleeding Reality
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (X), where X is 1 more than the current act number. For each point you fail by, discard 1 card at random from your hand (to a maximum of 3).

name: Last Looks
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if there is 3 or more damage on you. If you fail, take 1 direct horror and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Creature Feature
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] + [combat] (5). If you fail, draw the topmost [[Creature]] or [[Monster]] enemy in the encounter discard pile. If you failed and no enemy was drawn by this effect, take 1 horror and Creature Feature gains surge.

name: Possessed Extra
flavor: "There is only one longing! Back to Earth!" -Woman in the Moon

name: Possessed Extra
flavor: "Your record as a hunter of big game will add weight to your testimony- if we return!" -The Lost World

name: Possessed Extra
flavor: "Feast your eyes! Glut your soul on my accursed ugliness!" -The Phantom of the Opera

name: Erika Strand
text: Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if Erika Strand is ready: Reveal 1 random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed, ready each other [[Possessed]] enemy. Those enemies gain hunter and lose aloof until the end of the round.

name: Ghost Light
text:
Hunter.
Cannot be damaged except by [[Spell]], [[Relic]], [[Charm]], or encounter cards.
[reaction] After Ghost Light is successfully evaded: Deal 1 damage to it.

name: André Patel
text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test in which 2 or more cards were committed, exhaust André Patel: Immediately take an action as if it were your turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn).

name: A Cosmic Journey
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 health. Objective - Rebuild the telescope. When the round ends, if there are 3 shards on Helios Telescope, advance. (Hint: Explore the cosmos to rebuild the telescope.)
backText: Discard each enemy in play. Move each investigator to Space Set. Each investigator loses all of their clues. Add each location with victory X and no clues on it to the victory display. Remove each [[Cosmos]] and [[Ritual Site]] card from the game. Put each set-aside [[Set]] location into play unrevealed, along with Central Lot, (Blurred) side faceup. Search the victory display for Saturnite Monarch and put it into play at Central Lot with its (In An Alien Land) side faceup. Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Reel deck into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Add 1 [cultist], 1 [tablet], and 1 [elder_thing] to the chaos bag. Put the Helios Telescope story asset into play under the control of any investigator.
flavor: As you float noiselessly through space, André mentions that the Telescope must have caused this madness. With nothing but Saturn and its moons in front of you, you have no other choice but to explore these celestial bodies.

name: From Whence They Came
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 health, +1 fight, +1 evade, and gains elusive and the [[Saturnite]] trait. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 shard on Helios Telescope. Forced - If Helios Telescope has no shards on it, advance. Objective - Dethrone the monarch. If the Saturnite Monarch is defeated, advance.
backText:
If this act advanced via its forced effect:
The Monarch easily knocks you aside and snatches the telescope from your arms. It clicks rapidly at the militant Saturnites surrounding you. You don't understand what it has planned with this immense power, but you know it isn't good.
(→R1).
If this act advanced via its objective:
After only a short time with the Helios Telescope, you have begun to master its power. The Monarch falls to the floor, exhausted. You take aim and fire a fantastical beam at the Saturnite. With a shriek, the monarch and its subjects vanish, leaving nothing but memories.
Add the Helios Telescope to the victory display. (→R2).
flavor: The telescope's transporting beam may be able to send the Saturnites home, but the monarch is hellbent upon taking it.

name: High Ruler's Bastion
text: Forced - At the end of the round, if there are no clues on High Ruler's Bastion: Place clues on this location up to its clue value. [fast] If the Saturnite Monarch is in the victory display: Place 1 shard on Helios Telescope. (Max once per game.)

name: Teetawn Passage
text:
Teetawn Passage gets -X shroud, where X is the combined cost of each asset beneath Teetawn Passage.
[fast] If there are no clues on Teetawn Passage: Place 1 shard on Helios Telescope. (Max once per game.)

name: Ritual Site Teetawn
text: [action]: Make a sacrifice. Test [willpower] + [agility] (5). If you succeed, you may place up to two non-story assets from your hand or play area under Teetawn Passage. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If it is an enemy, draw it.

name: Tothis Barrens
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if there are any ready enemies at Tothis Barrens: Discard 1 shard on Tothis Barrens. [action] If there are no clues on Tothis Barrens: Move 1 shard on Tothis Barrens to Helios Telescope (Max once per game.)

name: Ritual Site Tothis
text: [fast] If there is no shard on Tothis Barrens: Disturb the ritual site. Discard the top 1 [per_investigator] cards from the encounter deck. Spawn each enemy discarded by this effect at Tothis Barrens. Place 1 resource token (from the token pool) on Tothis Barrens, as a shard.

name: Saturnite Monarch
text: Aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Saturnite Monarch. If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on Saturnite Monarch, add it to the victory display.

name: Saturnite Monarch
text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Saturnite Monarch gets +1 fight for each other enemy in play (to a max of +3). Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Saturnite Monarch is at the same location as Helios Telescope, remove 1 shard from Helios Telescope.

name: Saturnite Drudge Militia
text: Elusive. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to make loud noises. For each point you succeed by, deal 1 damage to Saturnite Drudge Militia. If you succeed by 2 or more, exhaust it.

name: Lost Asteroid
text: Revelation - Disengage from each enemy, put Lost Asteroid into play, and move to it. Investigators at Lost Asteroid get -1 to all skills during the mythos phase. [action]: Test [agility] (4). If you succeed, move to a revealed location and discard Lost Asteroid. (You may spend 4 resources to automatically succeed.)

name: Celestial Shower
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] + [agility] (6). If you fail, investigators at your location take a combined total of X damage, divided as you choose. X is the number of investigators at your location.

name: Rocket Ship
text:
Vehicle.
[fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Blast off! Move Rocket Ship to a [[Cosmos]] location. Reveal a token from the chaos bag. If a symbol token is revealed, each investigator leaves Rocket Ship. Then, flip this card over.
flavor: It seems bigger on the inside.

name: Curious Moon
text: Massive. Forced - If Curious Moon is successfully attacked or evaded, flip this card over.
flavor: Your reckless flight has attracted unwanted attention. You can't risk flying until this pesky planetoid is dealt with.

name: The Forgotten Island
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +1 health, +1 evade, and gains alert. [fast] Investigators at the same [[Jungle]] location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Move 1 seal from Ruins of the Serpent King to Allosaurus. Objective - When the round ends, if each surviving investigator and the Staff of the Serpent are at Jungle Set, advance.
backText: If the Allosaurus enemy is in play, set it aside out of play (keeping all tokens and attachments). Discard each other enemy in play. Move each investigator to Jungle Set. Each investigator loses all of their clues. Add each location with victory X and no clues on it to the victory display. Remove each [[Jungle]] location from the game. Put each set-aside [[Set]] location into play, unrevealed, along with Central Lot, (Blurred) side faceup. If the Allosaurus enemy is set aside, spawn it at Central Lot, (Rampaging Predator) side faceup. Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Reel deck into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Add 1 [cultist], 1 [tablet], and 1 [elder_thing] to the chaos bag.
flavor: You have found yourself in an actual tropical jungle. If the staff is behind these strange events, you should find it immediately.

name: Destroy the Source
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 health, +2 evade, and gains alert and the [[Dinosaur]] trait. [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Search the top 6 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy and spawn it at the location with the most investigators. Objective - Shatter the staff. If the Staff of the Serpent is defeated, advance.
flavor: Prehistoric terrors have begun to overrun Lot C. The staff's power is warping reality. To end this nightmare, you must destroy it!

name: Western Ridge
text: [reaction] When you attempt to evade an enemy at Western Ridge, choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: That enemy gets -2 evade for this evasion attempt. (Limit once per round.)

name: Tar Pit
text: Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Test [combat] (2). If you fail, you must either take 1 direct horror or discard an [[Ally]] or [[Footwear]] asset you control.

name: Eastern Ridge
text: [reaction] When you attempt to fight an enemy at Eastern Ridge, spend 3 resources: That enemy gets -2 fight for this attack. (Limit once per round.)

name: Jungle River
text: Forced - When you leave this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, you must either take 1 direct damage or discard a [[Weapon]] or [[Clothing]] asset you control.

name: Ruins of the Serpent King
text:
[action] Choose an enemy at Ruins of the Serpent King and spend X clues, where X is that enemy's fight value: Exhaust that enemy.
[action]: You attempt to wrest the staff from the altar. Test [willpower] + [combat] (6). If you succeed, take control of the Staff of the Serpent.
backText: Investigators cannot enter Ruins of the Serpent King while it has 1 or more seals on it.

name: Allosaurus
text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Allosaurus cannot be damaged or defeated. Forced - After a seal is placed on Allosaurus, if there are 4 seals on it: Remove each seal from Allosaurus and flip it over.

name: Allosaurus
text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Allosaurus gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After Allosaurus enters your location: You must either take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror, or Allosaurus defeats an [[Ally]] asset at your location.

name: Dromaeosaurus
text: Elusive. Hunter. Forced - After Dromaeosaurus engages you: You must either choose or discard 1 card from your hand, or Dromaeosaurus attacks you.
flavor: The creature moves rapidly and without a sound. This is no puppet from a film. This is a real predator.

name: Primordial Terror
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. If you fail by 3 or more, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Dinosaur]] and spawn it engaged with you. If the encounter deck was searched, shuffle it.

name: Unexpected Transformation
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is the highest resource cost among non-story assets you control. If you fail, you must either discard that asset, or take 1 horror for each [willpower] and [intellect] skill icon on that asset and 1 damage for each [combat] and [agility] skill icon on that asset.

name: The Abominable Contessa
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +1 fight, +1 health, and gains elusive. Exhausted enemies cannot be damaged. Objective - When the round ends, if the Accursed Cape is in the victory display, advance.
backText: If The Contessa is in play, heal all damage from her and set her aside, out of play. Discard each enemy in play. Move each investigator to Gothic Set. Each investigator loses all of their clues. Add each location with victory X and no clues on it to the victory display. Remove each [[Castle]] location from the game. Put each set-aside [[Set]] location into play, unrevealed, along with the Central Lot, (Blurred) side faceup. Search all out-of-play areas for The Contessa and spawn her at the Central Lot, (Enraged) side faceup. Search the victory display for the Accursed Cape and attach it to her. Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Reel deck into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Add 1 [cultist], 1 [tablet], and 1 [elder_thing] to the chaos bag.
flavor: You and André have found yourselves trapped in a horror film... and you are the victims. You have to find the Contessa and wrest her cursed cape from her!

name: Bloodbath
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 fight, +2 health, and gains patrol (The Contessa) and the [[Monster]] trait. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. Objective - Finish her! If The Contessa is defeated, advance.
flavor: An unnatural darkness overtakes Lot C. The Contessa has reclaimed her cape! If you hope to survive, you will need to defeat her once and for all.

name: Castle Hallways
text: Haunted - Choose and discard 1 card with at least 1 [knowledge] skill icon from your hand. If you cannot, ready The Contessa and move her to this location. [fast] Spend 1 resource: Move to any revealed [[Castle]] location.
backText: Forced - When you reveal this location: Test [intellect] (3). If you fail, ready The Contessa and move her to this location.

name: Catacombs
text: Haunted - Ready the nearest enemy. It moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase. Forced - When an enemy would be defeated in the Catacombs: Instead, heal all damage from it, disengage it from each investigator, and exhaust it.
backText: Forced - When you reveal this location: Test [combat] (3). If you fail, ready The Contessa and move her to this location.

name: Clock Tower
text: Haunted - Choose and discard 1 card with at least 1 [agility] skill icon from your hand. If you cannot, take 2 damage. This location is investigated using [agility] instead of the skill indicated by the investigation attempt.
backText: Forced - When you reveal this location: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, ready The Contessa and move her to this location.

name: Moonlit Garden
text: Haunted - Heal 2 damage from the nearest enemy. If no damage was healed by this effect, ready The Contessa and move her to this location. [reaction] After you successfully evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at Moonlit Garden by 2 or more: Move that enemy to a connecting location. (Group limit once per round.)
backText: Forced - When you reveal this location: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, ready The Contessa and move her to this location.

name: Throne of Blood
text: The Contessa cannot leave Throne of Blood. Forced - When you reveal this location: Search all in- and out-of-play areas for The Contessa and move her to Throne of Blood. Heal all damage from The Contessa and attach the set-aside Accursed Cape story asset to her. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at Throne of Blood
subname: Red as Blood, Black as Night
backText: As an additional cost to enter Throne of Blood, investigators at Gothic Set must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.

name: The Contessa
text: Elusive. Prey - Most remaining health. Forced - After you evade The Contessa: Ready her. She cannot attack you for the rest of the round. Forced - When The Contessa moves via her elusive keyword: Move her to the Throne of Blood instead.

name: The Contessa
text:
Elusive.
While the Accursed Cape is attached to The Contessa, she gets +1 damage and gains hunter and retaliate.

name: Vampire Thrall
text: Elusive. Hunter. Prey - Least remaining health. Forced - After Vampire Thrall attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.
flavor: "You have such a beautiful neck..."

name: Werewolf
text: Elusive. Hunter. Retaliate Prey - Most remaining health. This enemy moves twice via its hunter keyword.
flavor: This actor seems to have gotten a little too into character.

name: Hellfire
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (1) three times. For each of these skill tests you fail, take 1 damage.
flavor: "Fools! You can never defeat me!"

name: Vampire's Kiss
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if you have 3 or fewer damage on you. If you fail, take 1 damage. For each point you fail by, heal 1 damage from the nearest eligible enemy.
flavor: They say that the bite of a vampire is the most exquisite kind of pain imaginable.

name: Curse of the Rougarou
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at a [[Bayou]] location).
[cultist]: -2. If the Rougarou is in your location, reveal another token.
[tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, until the end of the round, you cannot move.
[elder_thing]: -4. If the Rougarou is at your location, it attacks you.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -3 (-6 instead if you are at a [[Bayou]] location).
[cultist]: -3. If the Rougarou is in your location, reveal another token.
[tablet]: Reveal another token. If you fail, until the end of the round, you cannot move.
[elder_thing]: -4. If the Rougarou is at your location or a connecting location, it attacks you.

name: A Creature of the Bayou
backText:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If The Rougarou is in play, find a non-[[Bayou]] location with the fewest clues on it. Move The Rougarou (one location at a time) until it enters that location.
If The Rougarou is not in play, after advancing to agenda 2a, add 1 doom to that agenda.
flavor: After arriving in New Orleans the next day, you start your investigation by asking the locals what they knew of the recent killings. As you suspected, most know very little of the incidents. You do manage to find several eyewitnesses who give similar descriptions of the creature: its lithe, muscular form, lanky arms, and wolf-like visage. A promising start - but if there is any truth to the rumors about this "curse", you'll have to talk to Lady Esprit herself.

name: The Rougarou Feeds
backText:
Shuffle all copies of On the Prowl from the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If The Rougarou is in play, find a non-[[Bayou]] location with the fewest clues on it. Move The Rougarou (one location at a time) until it enters that location.
If The Rougarou is not in play, after advancing to agenda 3a, add 1 doom to that agenda.
flavor: Around you, the bayou feasts. Flesh rips and jaws snap just beyond the trees, and light droplets of rain ripple upon the surface of the water. You can't tell exactly where the sounds are coming from. Perhaps it's the dreadful ambience of the bayou itself.

name: The Curse Spreads
text: Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if The Rougarou is not engaged with an investigator: Add 1 doom to this agenda.
backText:
The bearer of the Curse of the Rougarou weakness read the following (out loud):
You feel something dripping from your hand, and are surprised to find your knuckles bloody and torn. Nearby, the bard of a tree is smashed and dripping with blood. The anger of your failure slowly fades as you realize the blood is yours.
(→R1)
